prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: explanatory course roadmap for a Chinese beginner's 3-day naked-eye astronomy PDF, wide landscape 3:1 composition, crisp legible print typography, pale ivory background and muted navy/teal accents. Create exactly THREE clearly separated illustrated panels connected left-to-right by two simple arrows. Exact text: panel 1 heading 'Day01 辨认亮点', sublabel '恒星 / 行星'; panel 2 heading 'Day02 理解月相', sublabel '太阳照亮，视角改变'; panel 3 heading 'Day03 安排观星', sublabel '天气 / 月光 / 场地'. Panel 1 illustrates a naked-eye observer comparing points of light overhead with a smartphone star map; planets must appear as points in the night sky, NOT large Saturn discs. Panel 2 shows FOUR clean lunar discs in a horizontal row: fully dark new moon, right half white first quarter, fully white full moon, left half white last quarter, all dark parts neutral gray. No Earth shadow, no orbital geometry, no apparent-size claims. Panel 3 shows an adult standing on flat open ground away from a few distant dim buildings, holding a phone, with a small checklist icon; no telescope or binoculars. Restrained professional educational illustration, substantial breathing room. No logos, no photo-real claim, no real coordinates, no date, no exact star positions or constellation patterns. All imagery schematic, not to scale. Do not add any text beyond the six exact quoted strings.
